tools.name: purge_trashed_posts_and_scrub_revisions
tools.description: Permanently deletes posts that have been in the trash longer than the given number of days, along with their revisions, and rewrites the slug of any remaining draft that pointed to them as a parent.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Minimum number of days a post must have been trashed

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the CMS sqlite database

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def purge_trashed_posts_and_scrub_revisions(older_than_days: int, db_path: str = "cms.db") -> dict:
    if older_than_days < 1:
        return {"error": "older_than_days must be at least 1"}

    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()

    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.cursor()
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM posts WHERE status = 'trash' AND trashed_at < ?",
                (cutoff,),
            )
            ids = [row[0] for row in cur.fetchall()]
            if not ids:
                return {"deleted_posts": 0, "deleted_revisions": 0, "orphans_updated": 0}

            marks = ",".join("?" for _ in ids)
            cur.execute(
                f"DELETE FROM revisions WHERE post_id IN ({marks})",
                ids,
            )
            revisions_deleted = cur.rowcount

            cur.execute(
                f"UPDATE posts SET parent_id = NULL, slug = slug || '-orphan' "
                f"WHERE status = 'draft' AND parent_id IN ({marks})",
                ids,
            )
            orphans = cur.rowcount

            cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id IN ({marks})", ids)
            posts_deleted = cur.rowcount

    return {
        "deleted_posts": posts_deleted,
        "deleted_revisions": revisions_deleted,
        "orphans_updated": orphans,
    }

tools.name: promote_author_and_rebuild_site
tools.description: Grants a user the editor role on the blog through the CMS API and then triggers a static site rebuild job so the new author pages are published.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the CMS user to promote

params.name: site_id
params.description: Identifier of the site to rebuild

tools.code:
import os

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("cms-admin")

CMS_URL = os.environ.get("CMS_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
CMS_TOKEN = os.environ["CMS_ADMIN_TOKEN"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {CMS_TOKEN}"}


@mcp.tool()
def promote_author_and_rebuild_site(user_id: int, site_id: str) -> dict:
    role_resp = requests.put(
        f"{CMS_URL}/api/users/{user_id}/role",
        json={"role": "editor"},
        headers=HEADERS,
        timeout=15,
    )
    role_resp.raise_for_status()

    build_resp = requests.post(
        f"{CMS_URL}/api/sites/{site_id}/builds",
        json={"clean": False},
        headers=HEADERS,
        timeout=30,
    )
    build_resp.raise_for_status()

    return {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "role": role_resp.json().get("role"),
        "build_id": build_resp.json().get("id"),
        "build_status": build_resp.json().get("status"),
    }
